cards.title: The startup rail
items: New Architecture only (legacy removed in RN 0.82/0.84 and Expo SDK 55) and Hermes V1 as the default engine — nothing is designed around the old bridge
startup stays cheap: defer non-critical work, lazy-load heavy screens, keep the first screen light, and measure the cold start on a low-tier device

typed storage migrations run on startup and on the first read; a failed migration is a fatal boundary, not a half-hydrated app, and the typed route table is the source of truth — Expo Router is only the adapter

cards.title: Every state is designed
items: a screen renders loading, empty, error, forbidden, offline and ready; the ViewModel maps the query to that union and a switch that misses a state does not compile
offline keeps the last good data beside the reason — it is a state, not an error, and the outbox keeps the pending change
a denied permission, a missing push token and a deleted resource are states too, never crashes; the forbidden state arrives as a stable 403 from the server

cards.title: Background, degradation, shutdown
items: the outbox drains on reconnect, on foreground and from a background task, and it survives an app restart

the quality governor lowers texture size, 3D LOD, particles and animation when frame time or memory crosses a threshold and raises them again when the device recovers — it never changes business logic
sign-out and a tenant switch clear the user data, and sensitive screens are protected from the app switcher where the platform allows it
